verdict.rationale: Trello documents its own MCP server for connecting to any AI tool, which makes its boards a shared surface that agents can use. It also documents capturing every detail from email and Slack into the Trello Inbox, which supports carrying context in from other tools. The evidence is a single-line MCP claim with no detail on how card context, history or state is preserved or passed between agents. missing for 10: documented agent-to-agent handoff semantics, evidence that context and attachments are preserved across handoffs, MCP server tool/scope documentation, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: MCP server Connect Trello to any AI tool
Capture every vital detail from emails, Slack, and more directly into your Trello Inbox.
